## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; mixed sector returns and split leadership confirm a lack of directional conviction. Leadership concentrated across a few sectors (Top 5 span 3 sectors), supporting a neutral read.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Real Estate leads: AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +10.92%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials strength: LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +12.22%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication weak: TMUS (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND. Technology under pressure: MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -3.47%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) BELOW TREND. Financials show internal weakness: WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND, MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span 3 sectors).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: BKNG (1W: -6.85% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -3.53%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select tech/communications and regional bank exposures.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Highest 1W movers: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND; watch AMZN (1W: -3.34% | 1M: +7.44%) TREND EXHAUSTION as a short-term divergence. Overall momentum is mixed with pockets of strong cyclical/real-estate moves.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology is mixed-to-weak with larger-cap weakness offset by chip strength; AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND, but NOW (1W: -10.22% | 1M: -18.51%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND and CRM (1W: -12.63% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -2.14% (19 stocks) — rotation within tech from SaaS to select semiconductors.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials mixed with idiosyncratic extremes: BLK (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND while WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND and JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -1.25% (20 stocks) — watch divergence between asset managers and banks.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare is uneven: JNJ (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +4.47%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +0.47%) ABOVE TREND, offset by ISRG (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -3.53%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -1.51%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -0.93% (15 stocks) — defensive names show strength while select med-tech/biotech lag.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective cyclicals and defensives: XOM (1W: +4.24% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +13.29%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +4.74% | 1M: +9.84%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +4.47%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to broad-cap tech names showing persistent BELOW TREND action (MSFT, AAPL, CRM); style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, BLK (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +5.61% | 1M: +19.82%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NOW (1W: -10.22% | 1M: -18.51%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +9.75%, 13 stocks), Energy (1W: +1.02% | 1M: +11.34%, 8 stocks), Real Estate (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +4.70%, 6 stocks). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.14% | 1M: +0.19%, 19 stocks), Communication (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -3.79%, 7 stocks).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND — watch near recent highs for trend continuation. AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND — breakouts would confirm chip-cycle leadership. AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) BELOW TREND — watch for failure/new support to assess tech risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
JNJ (+60): CAPLYTA Phase 3 MDD data; price confirming (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +4.47%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. AMD (+60): analyst price-target shock; price confirming (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND. UNH (+60): Bernstein pick but price UNH (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -0.95%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from recent price action.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
DD (-70): PFAS RICO ruling clouding DuPont; monitor DD (not in top lists) for confirmed weakness. ADBE (-50): negative coverage and large 1W/1M drops — ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. INTU (-50): downgrade and outlook concerns — INTU (1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD, AMAT and XOM showing relative strength (AMD ABOVE TREND; AMAT ABOVE TREND; XOM ABOVE TREND). Key risk is split market internals—tech-cap weakness versus cyclical/defensive pockets—and notable sentiment divergences (UNH bullish sentiment but BELOW TREND; ADBE bearish sentiment confirming weakness).
